#| echo: FALSE

###### Loading up data and packages necessary #####
library(readr)

library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

data <- read_csv("data/data.csv")
data <- data[-c(1,2), ]

```{r}
#| echo: FALSE
#| include: false
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE 

### Data Wrangling  ####
data <- data |>
  select("Response_1":"style") 

data$Response_1 <- ifelse(data$Response_1 == "Strongly Disagree\n1\n", "1",
                        ifelse(data$Response_1 == "Strongly Agree\n5\n", "5",
                               data$Response_1))
data$Response_2 <- ifelse(data$Response_2 == "Strongly Disagree\n1\n", "1",
                        ifelse(data$Response_2 == "Strongly Agree\n5\n", "5",
                               data$Response_2))
data$Response_3 <- ifelse(data$Response_3 == "Strongly Disagree\n1\n", "1",
                        ifelse(data$Response_3 == "Strongly Agree\n5\n", "5",
                               data$Response_3))
data <- data[!is.na(data$Response_1), ]



data$Response_1 <- as.numeric(data$Response_1)
data$Response_2 <- as.numeric(data$Response_2)
data$Response_3 <- as.numeric(data$Response_3)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(Average = (Response_1 + Response_2 + Response_3) / 3)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false 
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| include: true
#| label: fig-2
#| fig-cap: Descriptive Statistics 


ds <- data %>%
  group_by(message, style) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            mean = mean(Average),
            S = sd(Average))

kable(ds)
```

```{r}
#| echo: FALSE
#| include: false
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE 

text_lm <- lm(Average ~ message * style, data = data)

# Assessing Conditions 
leveneTest(Average ~ message * style, data = data)
qplot(x = text_lm$residuals, bins = 6)
plot(text_lm, which = 2)
plot(text_lm, which = 1)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false 
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| include: true
#| label: fig-3
#| fig-cap: Boxplot


## Add title and caption 
ggplot(data, aes(x = style, y = Average, fill = message)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("forestgreen", "red")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Style",
       fill = "Message")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false 
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| include: true
#| label: fig-4
#| fig-cap: ANOVA 

text_lm <- lm(Average ~ message * style, data = data)
anova <- anova(text_lm)

kable(anova)
```
